title: Causal Rewards Protocol — Experiment Manifest
description: The experiment manifest IS the pre-analysis plan. Every field is frozen at Frozen and enters the manifest hash. It contains the assignment-seed COMMITMENT, never the seed. Per serialization.md §2, NO JSON number tokens appear in a hashed artifact: every numeric quantity is carried as a canonical integer-scaled decimal STRING (unsigned '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$', signed '^(0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$'), and all object keys are ASCII. Version this schema; changes are versioned migrations, never silent edits.

spec_version.description: Version of the protocol spec this manifest conforms to.

experiment_id.description: Stable unique identifier / slug for the experiment.

created_at.description: Author-time unix timestamp (seconds), as a canonical unsigned integer string (serialization.md §2). Informational; frozen with the manifest.

network.description: Target Solana cluster. MVP is devnet-only (Invariant 7); the single allowed value structurally enforces this.

primary_outcome.description: The single pre-registered primary outcome. Exactly one; secondary outcomes live under analysis_plan.sensitivity_analyses.

unit_of_measure.description: Human-readable unit label of the raw outcome metric, e.g. 'rmse_ug_per_m3'.

improvement_direction.description: Which direction of the raw metric is 'better'. Used by reward_policy.positive_improvement_transform to convert the effect into a non-negative improvement metric before applying the conservative bound.

estimand.description: Defines the causal estimand and the experimental unit. Invariant 4: the unit is ALWAYS a geographic cohort within a time block, never an individual device. unit_type is a const to enforce this structurally.

unit_type.description: The experimental unit. Single allowed value enforces Invariant 4.

scheme.description: How devices are grouped into geographic cohorts. Must be coarse-grained; exact coordinates never appear here or anywhere hashed (Invariant 5).

spatial_resolution.description: Coarseness of the cohort grouping (e.g. geohash precision length, or admin level). Kept coarse for data minimization.

cohort_count.description: Number of geographic cohorts (canonical unsigned integer string >= 1; serialization.md §2).

block_seconds.description: Length of one time block in seconds (canonical unsigned integer string >= 1; serialization.md §2).

block_count.description: Number of time blocks (canonical unsigned integer string >= 1; serialization.md §2).

effect_definition.description: Prose definition of the treatment effect at the cohort x time-block level, e.g. change in held-out RMSE caused by including a cohort's data.

design.description: Experimental design template. observational_replay is explicitly NOT eligible for the strongest causal claim.

eligible_for_strong_causal_claim.description: Whether this design supports the strongest additionality claim. MUST be false when template is observational_replay (enforced by the allOf below).

parameters.description: Design-specific parameters, frozen with the manifest as part of the pre-analysis plan (Invariant 1). All numeric values are canonical integer strings (serialization.md §2); all keys ASCII. This object MUST NOT contain any simulator ground-truth knob (true_effect, interference magnitude, confounding, Sybil parameters) — those are simulation inputs, never manifest fields (Invariant 5/6). interference_assumption declares the (untestable) no-interference/partial-interference assumption the causal claim rests on. For template=switchback, carryover_blocks and washout_blocks are additionally required (frozen so the discarded-block set is part of the pre-analysis plan, not chosen after seeing outcomes).

interference_assumption.description: The frozen cross-unit interference assumption underpinning the causal estimand. 'no_interference' = SUTVA at the cohort x time-block level. 'partial_interference_within_cohort' = interference is contained within a cohort; distinct cohorts do not interfere (the standard cluster-randomization assumption). 'spatial_bounded' = interference is limited to adjacent cohorts within the stated spatial_resolution; requires a separate spillover analysis.

carryover_blocks.description: Switchback only: number of trailing time blocks over which a treatment switch's effect is assumed to persist (canonical unsigned integer string; serialization.md §2).

washout_blocks.description: Switchback only: number of leading time blocks discarded from analysis after each switch to neutralize carryover. MUST be >= carryover_blocks (enforced by the causal engine). Canonical unsigned integer string; serialization.md §2.

treated_fraction_micro.description: Target fraction of units assigned to treatment, micro-scaled at 1e6 as a canonical unsigned integer string ('500000' = 0.5). Semantic range [0, 1000000] enforced by the producer/verifier (serialization.md §2.3).

assignment.description: Carries the assignment-seed COMMITMENT only. The seed is revealed later via reveal_seed AFTER freeze (Invariant 1, freeze-before-reveal). The seed itself MUST NOT appear in the manifest; the schema has no property to hold it.

scheme.description: Commitment construction (serialization.md §7.2), matching the verifier reference exactly. commitment = SHA-256("CRP-seed-commit-v1" || seed), where the domain tag is ASCII bytes and seed is the raw 32-byte assignment seed. There is NO salt: a 32-byte high-entropy seed is its own hiding randomness. reveal_seed later supplies the 32-byte seed; the verifier recomputes and compares.

commitment_hex.description: 64 lowercase hex chars = SHA-256 commitment to the assignment seed.

analysis_plan.description: The frozen analysis plan. Pinned estimator, SE method, confidence level and its integer-scaled critical value, minimum-sample rule, and the analysis container digest. Freezing this before reveal is Invariant 1; pinning the container is Invariant 2.

standard_error_method.description: Frozen SE method (Invariant 1). Enum semantics: 'cluster_robust' = CR1 cluster-robust sandwich on the cohort; 'matched_pair' = paired SE within a frozen matched stratum; 'classical' = homoskedastic OLS SE. 'hac' has NO frozen bandwidth field and MUST NOT be interpreted as a kernel with an analysis-time bandwidth (that would be an unfrozen analyst degree of freedom, Invariant 1); for template=switchback it is defined narrowly as UNRESTRICTED CLUSTERING ON THE GEO GROUP (arbitrary within-geo serial correlation, strictly more general than a truncated Newey-West kernel). This narrowing resolves the former hac_bandwidth_blocks open item as documentation; no bandwidth field is added. See causal-engine/docs/modeling-notes.md §1.

test_sidedness.description: Conservative payouts use a one-sided lower confidence bound on the improvement metric (Invariant 3).

confidence_level_micro.description: Confidence level micro-scaled at 1e6 as a canonical unsigned integer string ('950000' = 0.95). Semantic range (0, 1000000) enforced by producer/verifier.

critical_value_micro.description: The one-sided critical value used in conservative_effect = max(0, effect - critical_value * SE). Micro-scaled at 1e6 as a canonical unsigned integer string ('1645000' = 1.645). Frozen explicitly for determinism; MUST be consistent with confidence_level_micro, critical_value_reference, and (for student_t) df.

critical_value_reference.description: The distribution the critical value is taken from, for auditability. When 'student_t', the df field is REQUIRED so the critical value is reproducible without recomputation (Invariant 2).

df.description: Degrees of freedom for the reference distribution, frozen as a canonical unsigned integer string >= 1 (serialization.md §2). REQUIRED iff critical_value_reference = 'student_t' (enforced by the allOf below); MUST NOT be present for 'normal_approx' (a normal reference has no finite df). For cluster-robust inference the conventional choice is df = (number of clusters - 1). Freezing df makes critical_value_micro auditable and reproducible without re-deriving a quantile.

minimum_sample.description: Minimum-sample rule (Invariant 3). A cohort failing ANY of these thresholds is ineligible and contributes zero to any payout.

analysis_container_digest.description: Digest of the pinned analysis container (OCI image). Reproducibility depends on this being frozen (Invariant 2).

reward_policy.description: Two-stage reward policy (see reward-policy.md). Stage 1: cohort valuation via the conservative effect curve. Stage 2: frozen quality-weighted split WITHIN each cohort. Budget is fixed; total payout can never exceed it (Invariant 3).

budget_base_units.description: Fixed total budget in the mint's base units, as a canonical unsigned integer string >= 1 (serialization.md §2, base-units class, scale 1). Sum of all payouts MUST be <= this.

mint.description: SPL mint (base58 pubkey) on devnet. No mainnet mint permitted (Invariant 7).

positive_improvement_transform.description: Deterministic map from the raw primary-outcome effect to a non-negative 'improvement' metric before applying the conservative bound. 'signed' keeps the sign consistent with improvement_direction; the reward curve then clamps negatives to zero.

effect_scale.description: Signed integer scale EXPONENT (serialization.md §2.2 scale-exponent class) for the improvement metric and the reward-curve input axis, as a canonical signed integer string. '-6' means values are expressed at 1e-6 resolution. Semantic range [-12, 0] enforced by producer/verifier.

reward_curve.description: Stage-1 conservative effect curve: a monotonic non-decreasing, piecewise-linear map from the cohort conservative improvement (integer-scaled at effect_scale) to an absolute cohort allocation ceiling in base units. Must map input 0 to output 0.

breakpoints.description: Ordered array of [input_scaled_effect, output_base_units] pairs, each element a canonical unsigned integer STRING (serialization.md §2). Strictly increasing in input; non-decreasing in output; first pair MUST be ['0', '0']. Array order is significant and preserved by the serializer. Values below the first / above the last breakpoint are clamped.

reward_curve_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical bytes of reward_curve (serialization.md). Redundant commitment so the curve cannot be silently altered.

intra_cohort_split.description: Stage-2 frozen rule for splitting a cohort's allocation among its participants. Quality-weighted; weights derived deterministically from anchored evidence only.

weight_formula.description: A frozen weight expression in the CRP-WS1 grammar (reward-policy.md): a normalized weighted SUM over declared non-negative quality attributes, w_i = sum_k coef_k * attr_k(i). Syntax is exactly 'coef*attr' terms joined by ' + ' (single spaces). coef is a canonical unsigned integer string; attr is a snake_case identifier drawn from the closed attribute vocabulary in reward-policy.md. No products of two attributes, no other operators, no free-form expressions. Attributes are non-negative integers derived deterministically from anchored evidence only (no off-manifest inputs).

weight_scale.description: Signed integer scale EXPONENT (serialization.md §2.2 scale-exponent class) documenting the resolution of the resulting weight, as a canonical signed integer string. Within-cohort normalization (w_i / sum_j w_j) makes the absolute scale immaterial to the split ratio. Semantic range [-12, 0] enforced by producer/verifier.

overflow_policy.description: If summed cohort allocations exceed the budget, scale all allocations down by the single factor min(1, budget / sum). Guarantees total <= budget (Invariant 3).

unused_budget_policy.description: Budget not allocated (cohorts with zero conservative value, or headroom under the curve) is recoverable via close_experiment; never redistributed to force payout.

windows.description: Lifecycle windows as integer unix seconds. Ordering guards are enforced by the state machine and freeze_experiment pre-conditions (state-machine.md).

authorities.description: On-chain authorities. State-changing, frozen-record-affecting instructions (freeze, resolve_challenge, finalize) require the multisig. Coordinator and evaluator are constrained single roles.

threshold.description: Multisig threshold, canonical unsigned integer string >= 1 (serialization.md §2). Semantic constraint threshold <= len(signers) enforced by producer/verifier.

challenge_bond_base_units.description: Bond a challenger must post to open_challenge, as a canonical unsigned integer string >= 1 (serialization.md §2, base-units class). Griefing deterrent (threat-model.md).
